arStrings.szText: {if:SF.IsMythic}{c_mythic}{/if}Your {c_important}Golem{/c} will consume one of your {c_important}Skeleton Mages{/c} or {c_important}Skeleton Warriors{/c} every {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds, healing to full Life and gaining {if:SF.IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}[Affix_Value_1|%x|]{/c} increased damage for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} seconds.{if:SF.IsMythic}{/c_mythic}{/if}
